limits: Elapsed device-global totals include background and preemption; nested upload bookkeeping is included in wrapper. Control retains call-count bookkeeping; ON adds clock queries AND enabled tick/read accounting. Ratio measures the enabled-profile increment, not clock queries alone or all bookkeeping versus untouched112. Calibration covers direct DDI queries, not whole profiler wrappers. No physical extrapolation, optimization or release qualification. All popup/warning/error evidence retained.
